Cadre AI is an AI strategy and implementation firm that helps businesses go from AI confusion to AI confidence. We help you pinpoint the right AI opportunities, implement them seamlessly, and deliver real business impact—focused on driving revenue growth and improving EBITDA. Our approach is to go department by department to identify and implement AI workflows and agents that unlock real ROI. More: cadre.ai/  
Want to learn how this applies to your business? A Cadre AI strategist can walk you through it.

Cadre offers four core services:  
- AI Strategy (including the 45-day AI Transformation Intensive)  
- AI Leadership & Facilitation (workshops and sessions to align teams)  
- AI Engineering (workflow automation and system integration)  
- AI Agents (building prompts, assistants, and voice agents with guardrails)  

More: cadre.ai/services
